department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

deadline.value: Applications are taken year-round; University Fellowship nominations favor international applicants who complete by the last business day of November.
deadline.quote: The MSE and WE graduate programs accept applications throughout the year on an on-going basis--we do not have set deadlines for application submission, per se.

funding.value: Admission depends on GRA positions being available; students may be admitted without GRA support.
funding.quote: Applicants are admitted in every term if Graduate Research Associateship (GRA) positions are available for a given term.

also.quote: Admission to the graduate programs (MSE or WE) without accompanying GRA support may be provided to qualified applicants.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is the minimum.
entry_route.quote: An earned baccalaureate (B.S., B.A.) or professional degree from an accredited college or university by the expected date of entry into the program.
